core_obligations: Part (1) is a re-reading of a known proof: the author notes that the statement was proved under the stronger assumption that the regular part of M_{zeta^bullet}(V,W) is non-empty in the cited paper, but that the proof there actually yields the present statement, the point being that the fibre of the lifted map over the origin is a subvariety of the affine moduli space with the trivial factor removed (proof lines 1578-1586).

Part (2) uses that the restriction of pi to the preimage of a stratum is a fibre bundle, which the author derives from the displayed commutative diagram and the remark after it (proof lines 1588-1590).
The dimension bookkeeping: by part (1) there is a stratum whose dimension equals the dimension of M_zeta(V,W), so the image of pi has the same dimension as its source (proof lines 1590-1593).
Conclusion: the fibre-dimension bound of part (1) together with that dimension equality gives semismallness of pi with respect to the stratification by the images of the strata (proof line 1593).
proof_roadmap: 第 (1) 部分：沿用被引论文在更强假设下给出的证明，其要点是提升后映射在原点的纤维是去掉了平凡因子之后的仿射代数簇中的子簇；作者注明该证明其实给出了这里的结论。
第 (2) 部分：由交换图与随后的注记得到 pi 在每个 strata 的原像上是纤维丛；再由 (1) 找到维数等于源的 strata，于是像的维数等于源的维数，结合 (1) 的纤维维数上界得到 semismall。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the pair of results that make the morphism between the two quiver varieties well behaved (author Proposition at source lines 1553-1575, label prop:semismall): the fibre over a point of a stratum has dimension at most half the difference of the dimensions of source and stratum, and the map restricted to its image is semismall for the stratification by the images of the strata. Part (1) is a strengthening of a result proved in the cited paper under the extra hypothesis that the regular part of the target moduli space is non-empty, and the content is the author's observation that the original proof works without it, the mechanism being that the fibre of the lifted map over the origin sits inside an affine algebraic manifold with the trivial factor removed (proof lines 1578-1586). Part (2) then combines the fibre-bundle property of the restrictions with the dimension bookkeeping forced by part (1) (proof lines 1588-1593). H2.
